title: Marketing Communication Skills and Public Speaking Methods

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to deliver effective presentations before an audience.
Students will learn how to plan and prepare for public speaking engagements.
Students will understand the role and function of public relations in organizations.
Students will gain knowledge on organizing events as part of public relations activities.
Students will learn techniques for managing crises within public relations contexts.
Students will acquire skills in managing fundraising efforts through public relations.
Students will improve their writing abilities relevant to public relations.
